title: Fix sleep settings (P0)
description: Prevent the laptop from sleeping, hibernating, or turning off the display during long runs. This is blocking all other work.
objectives: Set AC standby timeout to never (0)
Set AC hibernate timeout to never (0)
Set AC monitor/display timeout to never (0)
Verify all three with powercfg /query and report the values
constraints: AC power settings only; leave battery settings unchanged
